$comment: Reviewed 2026-11-01. CI went red because GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 / CVE-2026-118764 (minimatch, moderate) was published 2026-10-30 and reaches 15 packages in the electron-builder build chain; there is NO semver-compatible fix (npm audit fix --dry-run changes 0 packages) and NO fixed release exists in any consumer's range. All 15 findings are devDependencies-only build tooling: desktop has no runtime npm dependency at all (npm audit --omit=dev reports 0 findings; the shipped app is the Electron kernel plus repository source), and the vulnerable code path needs an attacker-controlled glob pattern at package time, which the build never accepts. Every waiver below expires 2027-01-30 (90 days) to force a scheduled re-review; the gate's severity floor, escalation check and expiry check are unchanged. Remediation evidence and the rejected alternative are recorded in docs note 'desktop audit waiver 2026-11-01' (see team report): forcing minimatch@11.0.3 through npm overrides was tested in an isolated tree and breaks the toolchain -- @electron/asar silently produced an EMPTY app.asar (entries=[] instead of 3, unpackedDir=false), dir-compare threw 'TypeError: minimatch_1.default is not a function' and glob@7 threw 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading charAt)'.

gateChecklist.severityThresholds: unchanged: every low/moderate/high/critical finding must be registered, escalation and expiry are still fatal
gateChecklist.runtimeImpact: none: `npm audit --omit=dev` is 0 findings, desktop ships no runtime npm dependencies
gateChecklist.nextReview: 2027-01-30 (waivers expire automatically and fail the gate)

packages.scope: dev-only build chain, never reaches the runtime payload
packages.reason: GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 (CVE-2026-118764, CWE-405, CVSS v4 6.9, availability-only impact) is fixed only in minimatch >= 11.0.1, and no consumer in the electron-builder 26.18.0 tree accepts that major (app-builder-lib pins ^10, filelist ^5, @electron/universal ^9, glob@7 and dir-compare ^3). electron-builder 26.18.0 is the latest stable (27.x is alpha only) and its newest transitive versions still depend on minimatch < 11 (dir-compare 5.0.0 -> ^3.0.5, filelist 2.0.2 -> ^10.2.1, @electron/asar 4.3.1 -> ^10.0.1), so no upstream upgrade clears it. The amplification needs an attacker-controlled glob pattern with optimizationLevel >= 2; every pattern expanded here is repository-controlled build metadata.
packages.remediationEvidence: npm audit fix --dry-run: added=0 removed=0 changed=0. Forced npm overrides minimatch@11.0.3 tested in an isolated install: @electron/asar produced an empty app.asar, dir-compare threw TypeError (minimatch default export is no longer callable), glob@7 threw TypeError. Fix is blocked on upstream toolchain majors.

packages.remediationEvidence: Blocked with the minimatch waiver; latest @electron/asar 4.3.1 still requires minimatch ^10.
